estimates.name: INTRODUCTION
estimates.t: The purpose of this Management's Discussion and Analysis is to provide an understanding of our results of operations and consolidated financial condition.

estimates.name: BUSINESS OVERVIEW
estimates.t: Originally founded in 1946 as United Fire & Casualty Company, United Fire Group, Inc.

estimates.name: Reportable Segments
estimates.t: Our property and casualty insurance business operates and reports as one business segment.

estimates.name: Products and Lines of Business
estimates.t: The reinsurance operation supports primarily commercial lines of business but also assumes risk in professional, financial and personal lines of insurance.

estimates.name: Lloyd's of London ("Lloyd's") Syndicates
estimates.t: The Company is a member of Lloyd's through its insurance subsidiary, McIntyre Cedar Corporate Member LLP.

estimates.name: Pooling Arrangement
estimates.t: All of our property and casualty insurance subsidiaries belong to an intercompany reinsurance pooling arrangement.

estimates.name: Geographic Concentration
estimates.t: For the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026, approximately 50 percent of our property and casualty premiums were written in Texas, California, New Jersey, Iowa, and Florida.
